item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 24/Apr/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be appreciably cooler over the coast of Guangdong today. Meanwhile, upper-air disturbances will bring showers and squally thunderstorms to the region. Showers will be heavy at times. With the upper-air disturbances departing, the weather will improve slightly over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend. A trough of low pressure is expected to develop gradually over southern China early to midweek next week. The weather will become unsettled again over the region.
